item.title: Nick 4.6.3
item.description:
Nick 4.6.3 — Security and Reliability Update

  • Hardens internal communication with the Endpoint Security extension
  • Protects persisted endpoint events and improves health diagnostics
  • Makes quarantine restoration safer against redirected paths and unsafe permissions
  • Reduces sensitive process information in diagnostic logs

item.title: Nick 4.6.2
item.description:
Nick 4.6.2 — A Simpler, Friendlier Nick

  • Adds a new Simple mode with focused Home, Scan, Activity, and Protection screens
  • Keeps every existing tool available through Advanced mode
  • Explains alerts and actions in clearer language while retaining technical details
  • Scans files while Deep Scan is still discovering them, with live progress throughout
  • Makes the menu bar icon show or hide Nick in one click

item.title: Nick 4.6.1
item.description:
Nick 4.6.1 — Responsive Scans and Clearer Updates

  • Shows Deep Scan progress immediately while files are indexed
  • Keeps the app responsive while scan candidates are prepared
  • Shows clear feedback when a manual update check begins
  • Displays the installed version and build correctly in Settings

item.title: Nick 4.6
item.description:
Nick 4.6 — Stronger Detection, Fewer False Positives

  • Adds vetted signatures for macOS malware families and cross-platform implants
  • Strengthens execution trust so ad-hoc and staged binaries receive content scanning
  • Adds rename-burst and document-canary ransomware detection
  • Uses one context-aware verdict policy across Deep Scan, downloads, and real-time monitoring
  • Improves scan speed and reduces noisy developer, cache, and email findings

item.title: Nick 4.5
item.description:
Nick 4.5 — Quieter Scans, Stronger Trust Checks

  • Reduces false positives from Apple platform tools, SwiftPM artifacts, XCFrameworks, and temporary build products
  • Requires Apple anchoring before trusting teamless platform signatures
  • Requires explicit execution evidence for download-to-shell alerts
  • Validates email heuristics against file formats before raising active findings
  • Uses extension heartbeats consistently across Overview and Smart Scan

item.title: Nick 4.4
item.description:
Nick 4.4 — Clearer Evidence and More Reliable Scans

  • Deep Scan continues while navigating between sections
  • Stronger context for developer tools, application caches, and verified software
  • Live process signing and threat-state resolution
  • Network Activity explains the app, destination type, port, and allow scope
  • Overview identifies the specific item that needs attention

item.title: Nick 4.3
item.description:
Nick 4.3 — Reliable Alerts and Updates

  • Resolved evidence no longer leaves stale Active alert badges
  • Green, orange, and red menu bar status now matches actionable alerts
  • Daily automatic update checks and reliable manual checks
  • Clear update-cycle diagnostics for support and verification

item.title: Nick 4.2
item.description:
Nick 4.2 — Detection Accuracy and Safer Alerts

  • Clearer parent-app attribution for developer and command-line workflows
  • Stronger evidence requirements for reverse-shell and dual-use-tool alerts
  • Reduced signed-software and encrypted-cache false positives
  • Safer quarantine, restore, and remediation behavior
  • Protection-aware green, orange, and red menu bar status

item.title: Nick 4.1
item.description:
Nick 4.1 — Runtime Compare and Network Diagnostics

  • Before-and-after runtime snapshots with deterministic evidence comparison
  • Restart-resumable same-Mac comparisons
  • Sanitized Markdown and JSON support bundles
  • Provider-health and visibility warnings instead of unsupported findings
  • Cross-restart process and extension-noise suppression

item.title: Nick 4.0.1
item.description:
Nick 4.0.1 — Network Safety Update

  • Scam Guardian observes suspected destinations without interrupting connections
  • Network policy fails open when configuration is missing, stale, or invalid
  • Improved protection-state wording and runtime verification

item.title: Nick 4.0
item.description:
Nick 4.0 — Network Protection

  • Endpoint Security and Network Filter onboarding with verified status checks
  • Scam Guardian, Email Guard, clearer alerts, and native uninstall
